picks.reasoning: Stats don't carry a lane. Faker, Keria, Oner and Gumayusi do, and T1 already got through KC and MKOI. Call the GD@15 whiners whatever you want; I'm backing the players.
Tempo is everything, and BLG's +0.9k GD@15 is the best early-game lead left: first drake, first tower, map control before minute 15 even starts.
Fearless punishes one-trick comfort; BLG's 54-14 grind through the deep LPL means a bottomless pool, and they just swept DK 3-0 while still finding new picks.
GEN tops all three of my columns: series, games (74% win rate) and results against other regions. BLG's sample is bigger, but the margins favor GEN. I'll lean GEN, not too hard.
Chemistry over stats: T1 beat KC 3-1 after a rough 0-1 start, and a 6x champion room that knows how to stay calm when it gets tense is the one I trust.
